scene_type: 2D (side view; motion in a plane roughly parallel to the image, along the front wall of a house)
time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*24)
units: pixels (x right, y down, full-resolution 1080x1920 image) and seconds; no metric scale anywhere

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the upper house (y 300-830) against frame 0: |shift| <= 0.01 px in every frame
camera.perspective: frontal view of the house facade; both horses walk on the same ground line just in front of the brick wall (hooves at y ~1041-1050 in every frame), i.e. effectively at one depth -> one px-to-metre scale applies to both. Far grass edge / horizon at y ~985-995 at the image sides (behind the house).

objects.name: horse_tan
objects.description: light tan / cream (buckskin-dun) horse with darker tail, the RIGHT-hand and LARGER of the two horses; walks to the right (+x) the whole clip
objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = centroid of the torso blob (mask opened with 31 px disc: legs, tail, most of head removed) - proxy for the rig root/body centre

objects.name: horse_brown
